class: An Exit (Positions Paper, Exit > Confirm) ends with no order sent and no sentence naming the leg and the reason: the page closes the dialog itself (failed or unreadable 5 s re-read, legs changed), returns early (busy, stale, empty), or maps an unknown outcome (superseded POST, proxy 408/429) to ready or refused.
mechanism: 27 Nov 2026 live: Positions (Paper) Exit > Confirm did not exit the leg and showed no message; Exit on B-P1 did nothing. PaperStrategies.vue closed the dialog and cleared the ticks in fail(), show(), settle() and the stale branch of doExit with no text, so a failed re-read during the dialog made Confirm silent and left Exit disabled with no reason. 11 paths: ask() early return, doExit no-dialog, busy, stale, refused-unchanged lock, four-part truncation (what_happened only), superseded POST to READY, failed read, unreadable 2xx, settle on an unreadable or changed group, ticks cleared with no reason on the button.

first_seen.evidence: owner live evidence 27 Nov 2026; frontend/tests/paper-strategies.test.js 'an Exit never ends with nothing done and nothing said' red on 206a9f06: 12 of 12 new cases failed

fix: lib/usePaperExit.js exitEndText is the one wording door and PaperStrategies endExit(reason, legs, parts) the one path of an Exit that ends without an order or with a refusal: a failed read keeps the open dialog blocked with '<leg>: Prices are not live; ...'; changed legs close it with a note; a refusal shows all four parts and the leg; paperPostOutcome treats everything but 400/409/422 as unknown.

detection.note: Tests per path, not a scan. The builder (StrategyBuilderPage cancelPaperDialog on exitBlocked) still closes its dialog on a block with only the panel line; same class, not yet moved to endExit.
